model.note: Storage bits only, excludes pointer/control/clock/fanout/placement costs. Baseline is actual L grouped MEMORY_READ_EXTRA9. No ring-cap relaxation assumed; parent owns segmented S1 candidate. Network transport is charged once: native outerML9 + normalized43 =52, not52+43.

selected_tag_candidate.note: Parent RTL estimate inclusive S1 plus S2 pointers/output; compare net area against baseline after synthesis, do not add rejected +4935FF/head price. SRAM capacity and physical macro outline accounted separately.
